label: Yandex Reverse Image Search API
title: Yandex Reverse Image Search API: Upload, OCR & Tags
metaDescription: Find where an image appears online with Yandex: paste a link or upload a file to get matching pages, similar images, other sizes, OCR text and tags.
intro: Search Yandex by picture instead of keywords: paste an image link or upload a file and get the pages where it appears, visually similar images, other resolutions, the text read from the picture and descriptive tags, in all Yandex regions.
useCases: Find copies of your images across the web
Locate a higher-resolution version of a picture
Read the text in many images at once (OCR)

faq.q: How do I send an image file to Yandex reverse image search from code?
faq.a: Start the actor through the Apify API with your image as a public link or an uploaded file in the input, then read the results as JSON. You don't call Yandex's upload endpoint yourself.
